Narrate one subject's facts with Claude via ellmer

Source: R/subject_narrative_claude.R
subject_narrative_claude.Rd

Default narrator for [subject_narrative()]. Sends the derived facts text (not the raw data) to Claude and returns a short plain-language summary. Requires the `ellmer` package and an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

Usage

subject_narrative_claude(
  facts_text,
  facts = NULL,
  model = "claude-opus-5-5",
  chat = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

facts_text

The facts block from [subject_narrative_facts_text()].

facts

The structured facts list (unused here; accepted so narrators share one signature).

model

Claude model id (default `"claude-opus-5-5"`).

chat

An optional pre-built ellmer chat object (mainly for testing).

...

Ignored.

Value

A single character string: the narrative.
